section: Iterate — change: Zug municipality data ships with the app
title: Propose the responsible municipality from the official locality list, let the midwife correct it
context: Postcode→municipality is not 1:1 in canton Zug (e.g. 6314 Neuägeri spans four municipalities) and the hand-kept Supabase table had drifted (6319 Allenwinden). Supabase is being dropped for Bunny hosting.
decision: Commit a snapshot of swisstopo's Amtliches Ortschaftenverzeichnis (localities with any Zug address, per-municipality address shares) and the 11 recipients. Pre-select at >=80 % share, hint at >=5 % shared or outside Zug, block postcodes without a Zug locality; the midwife can always correct.
consequences: Invoice generation needs no network. Snapshot must be regenerated by hand (scripts/municipality-data) when localities change. Up to <5 % of a pre-selected locality may belong to another municipality without a hint (accepted rule). Out-of-canton localities rely on step 2 keeping the Zug filter (trg-9e70266a).
rationale: Official, reproducible source with address shares; product owner chose propose-and-correct over an exact per-building lookup that would send street and number to another service.
rejected: Federal building register lookup per address (extra data leaves the browser, runtime dependency); keeping a hand-maintained postcode table (repeats the drift).
